text:
sam: Quick heads up — planning a controlled cutover to v2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This will be a ramp: 0.5% -> 20% over 60m with two canaries. Posting plan here so ops/runtime/release-notes teams can align.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: schedule created by sam. version=v2 strategy=ramp start=0.5 end=20 duration=60m canaries=2 prechecks=queued

tess: Please ensure we can force-route by tenant id (ops pin) and by header `X-API-Client` value. For clients using old SDKs, fallback to v1.

noah: Adding automatic pause triggers: sustained 5xx > 0.8% for 3m OR p95 latency > baseline * 2.5 for 5m. On pause, deploy-bot will notify #eng-oncall and post details here.

ops_lead: I'll cover the first 30m. Escalation flow: if deploy-bot auto-pauses, we triage in the thread and decide pin vs rollback. If manual rollback needed, follow rollback checklist in runbook v3.

lina: Drafting release note blurb: "v2 endpoint: improved request streaming and header normalization. Note: clients should include X-API-Version; older clients without this header will continue on v1. SDKs >=1.5 recommended." Will add migration steps.

sam: Important: enable `client-header-fallback=true` on the gateway so unknown client headers map to legacy lane. Also enable metric `client_version_unknown_count`.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: metrics export=ok, canary tenants resolved, healthchecks=green. To start manually: `/deploybot start --id=3412349999`

noah: Add a safety mute window for billing spikes: if token_cost_per_min increases by >50% for 10m, pause. We saw cost regressions in last beta run.

ops_lead: Operator note: tenant pin API ready. Sample to pin:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/tenants/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"tenant":"beta-123","version":"v1","note":"post-cutover spike"}'
```

tess: I'll update the deploy checklist: confirm release-notes posted to #marketing and #customers 5m before start, confirm SDK callouts, confirm runbook link.

sam: Rollback policy: auto-pause on triggers. Manual rollback criteria: >1.5% 5xx across any region for 5m OR p95 up >40% across two regions for 10m -> full rollback to v1. If rollback happens, we will pin tenants with highest error counts and open an incident.

lina: I'm prepping a short FAQ for customers about header canonicalization and how to opt-out via `X-Api-Force: v1`. Will attach sample code.

deploy-bot: Note: to cancel scheduled rollout: `/deploybot cancel --id=3412349999`

noah: Add rapid telemetry: 1m/5m views for 5xx-rate, p95, client_version_unknown_count, pinned_tenants_count. Ops team watch these dashboards.

ops_lead: I'll be on rotation 01:50-03:30 UTC. If anything, post here and page eng-runtime after 5m unresolved anomalies.

sam: Any final concerns? If none, we'll start at 02:00 UTC and post canary results in this thread.

opinion-bot: (system) Reminder: update CHANGELOG and set release tags for v2.

olivia: small ask: include rollback communication template in the thread so CS can notify top affected customers quickly.

lina: Adding the CS template now and will paste into #customers at -3m.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled. Status updates will appear here: CANARY_STARTED -> CANARY_CHECKS -> RAMPING -> STABLE.
